verdicts.reason: Quotes are accurate but the divergence is verbal, not normative. 22.04.01 itself glosses D-04 as 'at the source' in its own Cross-Cut Notes (22.04.01-audience-geography-map.md:88 — 'Flagged streams must be excluded at the source'), and its DT-03(a) rationale is 'not at each consumer'. The domain CX states the operative behaviour without reference to the map at all (analytics-market-intelligence-cx.md:121 — '22.06 flags; consumers read the flag. Flagged streams are excluded upstream once, so downstream features consume corrected data and do not re-decide fraud'). Every file agrees on the product behaviour: 22.06 owns the flag, exclusion happens once upstream, no consumer re-decides fraud, late flags produce a disclosed restatement (22.04.01:58, analytics-market-intelligence-cx.md:143). What is left is where a single filter physically sits in the metrics pipeline — an architecture-layer placement question the domain already routes to a later stage (analytics-market-intelligence-cx.md:251 — 'Time-series metrics store, retention, restatement history | /create-prd-architecture'). No implementer reading the set concludes fraudulent streams reach 22.08.03's published proof; three files state the opposite explicitly.

The 'unresolved' label overstates the gap. CX-03 states the precedence in full ('live DSP connection > distributor file > manual entry, with the superseded value retained and inspectable rather than overwritten', 22.01-source-connections-ingestion-cx.md:73) and its role scoping fixes the interaction ('sees a conflict badge and picks a source of truth, or accepts the default precedence', same file:68), matching 22.01.04:50 ('neither value is destroyed … the superseded value inspectable'). That ordering is over-determined by the domain's provenance hierarchy rather than being one arbitrary candidate among many: 22.01.04 DT-02 ('an imported number is a self-claim; a fetched number is an attestation') and 22.01.03 D-05 ('Import-filled ranges are tagged claimed and excluded from attested coverage', 22.01.03-ingestion-health-gaps-freshness.md:170) both rank attested above claimed. Two competent implementers converge on attested-live-connection-wins with both values retained and a user override.

The owning file defines the alias explicitly. 22.01.03-ingestion-health-gaps-freshness.md:40-41 reads 'only user-actionable (`broken`) or permanent (`terminal`) failures surface' — i.e. `broken` IS the user-actionable class, and 22.01.03:57 gives its entry condition as auth failure (401/403, invalid_grant, token_revoked), which is exactly the expired-token case 22.01.02:65 describes. 22.01.02 also frames it as a classification, not an enum member ('transient-vs-terminal-vs-actionable classification lives at this boundary', 22.01.02-social-account-connection-sync.md:92), and 22.01.01:48 assigns state classification to 22.01.03 alone. No sixth state is created and the named gap follows from `broken` as specified.

Confirmed against the file and internally inconsistent as written. A's membership is literally 'fresh or stale' (22.01.03-ingestion-health-gaps-freshness.md:72-73), which drops a `degraded` source out of the attested set even though the same file states 'degraded never opens a gap — the data is late, not missing' (line 61-62) and 'no notification, no gap' (line 105), and even though degraded is a first-class state with its own entry/exit rules (line 56). The dominant-loss definition then enumerates A's complement as '(i.e. missing/broken/terminal/claim-only)' (line 76) — omitting degraded from both A and its complement, so the partition does not close. Concrete divergence: a source that returns HTTP 429 on its most recent attempt is `degraded` while its data is complete; a literal implementer drops it from A and, on a 5-source rollup, c = 0.80 boundary or lower flips a plain figure to 'at least X across N of M' (line 82), while an implementer following the gap-based principle counts it and states the number. The rollup's user-visible output differs, and the coverage rule is the gate 22.08.03's proof depends on.

Territory is not undefined — the happy path names it as a mapped column: '3. User maps columns to metrics (date, ISRC/UPC, territory, platform, plays)' (22.01.04-manual-file-based-metric-import.md, Happy Path step 3). The pending row's own text scopes the open part to the money side ('overlaps domain 10's royalty ingestion; boundary unresolved', line 57), and that boundary is precisely what Q-01 tracks with an owner and a live target ('Does domain 10 own statement parsing with 22 subscribing, or do both parse? … | Agent | /create-prd-architecture', line 97), reinforced by DT-01 ('The same file carries both money (10's concern) and plays (22's concern)'). Currency belongs to domain 10 under the index's own boundary ('Performance is not money; 10 owns the money', 22.08.01:125). Tracked deferral with an owner and a valid target.

The substantive question is answered by the sibling that owns contest state. 22.02.03-match-conflict-disambiguation-resolution.md:38-39 states the invariant flatly: 'contested state blocks binding, and blocking is loud. Nothing speculatively binds while contested, and a cascading invalidation (CX-01) never silently orphans numbers.' 22.02.02:79 applies the same rule at the child level ('The dispute wins (a contested recording blocks binding, D-02 of 22.02.03); a confirmation issued against the now-superseded pre-dispute state is rejected as stale'), and 22.02.02:93 fixes the outcome if the parent is revoked ('Every dependent catalog match invalidates — loudly, cascading, never silently orphaned'). The CX candidate ('freeze dependent confirmations while a parent is contested', 22.02-external-identity-catalog-matching-cx.md:38) is the direct application of that invariant, not a coin-flip; the residual sync-vs-async point (line 35) is explicitly subordinate to a cascade the file calls 'non-negotiable'.

A ratified decision in the same file settles the behaviour, and decisions outrank an open question. 22.03.01-playlist-placement-tracking.md:98 D-03: 'Contribution is always labelled an estimate, and never feeds verified proof' — the estimate exists and is constrained; the Role Lens (line 19) and 22.08.03:57 ('Estimated contribution (22.03.01) | Never in proof') both consume it as an existing artefact. Q-02 (line 106) is a stale-target 'should we reconsider' row with a named owner (User); its stale target is a tracking-hygiene defect, not a behavioural void — an implementer builds the labelled estimate per D-03 and no divergence arises. moscow-ledger.md:467 tiers the feature on Q-01 (index build/license), not on estimation.

The trigger is show completion, not booking creation: 'A show completes (domain 17 booking record). Attribution window opens; the city's pre-show baseline is already recorded' (22.04.03-show-impact-attribution.md, Happy Path steps 1-2). A rescheduled show completes on its new date and therefore opens a window on that date exactly like any other completed show; the Invalidated state (line 71) disposes of the window that was opened against the date the show did not happen — which is precisely what the edge-case row says ('Window invalidated, not measured', line 55). The justification the finding objects to ('a show that didn't happen has no impact') is true of the cancelled date, not of the show as an entity. Both readings converge on the same user-visible behaviour.

The finding concedes 'None strictly forced', and the answer is present twice inside the same unit: the child resolves it with a citation (22.05.01-unified-performance-dashboard.md:125 — 'RESOLVED — neither. ideation-index.md D-31 fixed the beachhead as v1 = session spine … all of domain 22 is phase-2+') and the domain index resolves the same question (analytics-market-intelligence-index.md:141 Q-06, struck through and RESOLVED). A stale unstruck parent row pointing at a completed stage is tracking hygiene over a decision that is recorded, cited and unambiguous — no spec ambiguity and no divergent implementation.

The States table supplies the behaviour the finding says must be invented: 'Declined | No coherent cohort | Explicit, non-judgmental' (22.05.04-peer-benchmarking-cohort-comparison.md:68), alongside 'Suppressed | Below anonymity floor' (line 67) and the neighbouring edge case 'User is a genuine outlier (very niche genre) | No meaningful cohort exists | Suppressed, framed neutrally — not as a deficiency' (line 52). A session player with no artist identity has no coherent cohort and therefore lands in Declined/Suppressed, both explicitly neutral. The credit-graph alternative is not left dangling either: DT-03 records it as a future direction (line 76) and Q-04 is RESOLVED with the structural ruling that it enters as an input from 22.08, not as this feature's v1 form (line 104, citing 22.08 CX #R-01). Choosing between two adjacent neutral-refusal states is presentation, not product invention.

Verified, and it is a two-way conflict rather than a bare deferral. The Role Lens promises the message as delivered behaviour: 'Sees an observed-risk indication on a promo vendor before buying, and a warning if a vendor they've used deteriorates' (22.06.02-promo-vendor-risk-scoring.md:20). The CX states the opposite default and leaves the exception open: 'A vendor's score changing notifies nobody — but an artist with an active campaign from a vendor whose score just deteriorated is arguably owed a warning, and that is a genuinely new alert class. [PENDING — Step 5]' (22.06-streaming-fraud-detection-cx.md:36), echoed at 22.06.02:57. Confirmed by inspection that none of Q-01..Q-04 (lines 97-100) covers this — those cover right-of-reply, rebranding, self-scoring and the monetisation principle — and the three sibling rows in that same table were explicitly re-pointed off completed stages while this marker was not. An implementer following the Role Lens ships an alert class; one following the CX ships nothing, and the difference spends 22.05.02's alert-noise budget.

The surviving feature names a non-search entry path in its own happy path: 'User finds an artist (via 22.07.03, or directly)' (22.07.01-artist-watchlists.md:36). The cut is not unacknowledged either — 22.07.03 Q-01 records it with the substitute named ('RESOLVED — no. It was cut … domain 05's services marketplace already offers essentially this search over the same people, consented by construction', 22.07.03-scouting-discovery-search.md:91), Q-02 works through the consequence (line 92), and the sub-domain index Q-02 records the selective cut (22.07-ar-scouting-watchlists-index.md:83). What remains is which target an empty-state CTA points at on a `could`-tier feature — an FE routing detail with two documented candidates (direct lookup, domain 05's consented search), not invented product behaviour. The CX-01 'address book' rationale is a value judgement MoSCoW knowingly overrode.
